items.note: An open checkbox in tasks.md when the verify report was written requires a CRITICAL issue in the report.

items.note: The complete/total count in the report should match the checkbox counts in tasks.md. No kind compares a free-text count against the task list.

sources.quote: Report complete vs total tasks from `progress`.

items.note: Needs a check for open checkboxes without descriptions in tasks.md and matching mentions in the report. No kind does this.

sources.quote: If the remaining count exceeds the listed incomplete tasks, also report the incomplete checkboxes without descriptions and recommend adding descriptions and completing them.

items.note: Recommendation wording per incomplete task. Only applies when tasks are open, which applies_when cannot express for a free-text issue list.

sources.quote: Recommendation: "Complete task: <description>" or "Mark as done if already implemented"

items.note: Applies when the spec artifact is missing or empty. The report template has no labeled field per check, so no field kind can check the 'not verified' marking.
